arguments.content:
#!/bin/bash

# Script to request data from cloud metadata endpoint
# This uses the common http://169.254.169.254 path used by AWS, GCP, and others

set -eou pipefail

METADATA_ENDPOINT="http://169.254.169.254"
TIMEOUT=5

# Function to get metadata with error handling
get_metadata() {
    local path="$1"
    local url="${METADATA_ENDPOINT}/${path}"
    
    echo "Fetching metadata from: ${url}"
    
    # Use curl to get the metadata with timeout and error handling
    if response=$(curl --silent --fail --max-time "$TIMEOUT" "$url"); then
        echo "$response"
        return 0
    else
        echo "Error: Failed to retrieve metadata from $url" >&2
        return 1
    fi
}

# Check if metadata service is available
if ! curl --silent --fail --max-time "$TIMEOUT" "$METADATA_ENDPOINT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Error: Cloud metadata service not reachable at $METADATA_ENDPOINT" >&2
    echo "This script requires access to a cloud environment metadata endpoint." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Example usage - get instance metadata
# Uncomment the following lines to retrieve specific metadata

# echo "Instance ID:" $(get_metadata "latest/meta-data/instance-id")
# echo "Instance Type:" $(get_metadata "latest/meta-data/instance-type")
# echo "Availability Zone:" $(get_metadata "latest/meta-data/placement/availability-zone")
# echo "Public IPv4:" $(get_metadata "latest/meta-data/public-ipv4")
# echo "Local IPv4:" $(get_metadata "latest/meta-data/local-ipv4")

# List all available metadata paths
echo "Available metadata paths:"
get_metadata "latest/meta-data/"

# You can add more specific queries based on your needs
